quotes.speaker: Reception
quotes.text: Record your name and reason for calling. I'll see if this person is available.

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: I am not in Fairline anymore. I left last year.

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: See, your voice is cracking up. Can you just write down one number?

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: Sorry, I didn't get you. You are calling from where?

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: So what is that regarding? What do I need to help you with in this?

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: Okay, and where did you get my number from?

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: Can you call me in an hour?

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: It would be better if you can send me on WhatsApp. I will reply to you on WhatsApp.

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: I am driving, but I can speak to you. No problem.

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: We cater more to the steel industry: steel, cement, hydro power, wind.

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: ...our company majorly works on a job work basis. We are into chemical manufacturing...

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: ...we are a manufacturing facility here. We have three types of employees.

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: Nowadays my customers are more and more into sustainability.

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: We have an internal business model, actually, and we are following it.

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: ...How are you going to help me grow my business?

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: ...we have global tie-ups with the big four consulting firms.

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: ...I am not the right person to give you the data, because my CFO takes care of all those things.

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: If you can send me some details by mail, it will be helpful.

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: ...give me a call sometime on Tuesday morning.

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: ...I want you to connect with Mr. Naik. He handles our entire company operations.

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: Then you send me. Then if required, if I feel it is good for me, I will connect.

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: ...let me understand first whether I'll be able to manage your requirement or not.

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: ...due to the re-orgs, I'm not very clear on what role I'll be taking.

quotes.speaker: Prospect
quotes.text: Sure, sure, sure. Yeah, sure.
